changelog:
facebook-ads-library-search v1.0.0

- Initial release: search the Meta Ad Library (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp ads) by keyword or Facebook page ID.
- Retrieves detailed ad data: creatives, copy, calls-to-action, publisher platforms, spend, impressions, reach estimates, and page transparency info.
- Supports advanced filters (status, ad type, media type, platforms, country), and paginated result fetching.
- No Facebook login required; operates only on data visible in the user’s browser.
- Limitations and usage guidelines documented, including handling of null fields and anti-scraping protections.
